retrieval_skill.name: mechanism_layered_regime_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve evidence that connects observed telemetry anomalies to the underlying mechanism, corrective intervention, and resulting regime transition.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasts may be distorted by corrupted observations, operational incidents, or interventions near the forecast boundary.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for incident reports and telemetry records covering the context window and forecast boundary; extract claims about overlap, intervention timing, causal mechanism, stabilization, and return to baseline.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a claim only when its source provenance and temporal scope are explicit and it distinguishes observed measurements from latent system behavior and regime changes; preserve exact-quote requirements where applicable.

decision_skill.name: validated_decaying_trend_selection
decision_skill.description: Forecast by selecting a recent window whose one-step trend behavior is empirically representative, then attenuating its estimated slope across the horizon.
decision_skill.applicability: When the latest observations reflect a transient trend or recovery and rolling-origin validation indicates that a local trend model outperforms seasonal or shape-matching alternatives.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Evaluate multiple recent window lengths using historical one-step trend errors, select the best-supported representative window, estimate its local slope, and decay that slope over the forecast horizon to avoid indefinite extrapolation.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when the selected window lacks sufficient validation support, a stable seasonal increment is clearly stronger, a structural break makes recent errors unrepresentative, or evidence indicates an abrupt deterministic return to a known level.
